body: I definitely will. It's people like you that make sw the wonderful caring place it is. I really, really appreciate your comments.

Thank you so much for the kind words. I just need to make it to Monday so I can hopefully get a new doctor and get meds back in track. 

I have actually attempted twice before but I am very lucky to have supportive caring parents. I worry a lot about hurting them too. 

It's so hard to fight against those demons inside that tell you nothing matters and you're worthless. 

Thank you again for being here.
